agent_explanation: High-speed inter-body collision imparts ~30.6 m/s to light body 0. With dt~0.017 and substeps=18, displacement per substep ~0.52m exceeds wall handling accuracy, causing it to tunnel/outrun positional correction and exit arena by 0.25m beyond limit. Reducing dt to 0.001 makes same physical scenario pass, proving numerical integration/substep insufficiency.
